subject: botany_2
question_text: Compare imbibing capacities of pea and wheat seeds.

verification.note: Sourced from "Sr. Botany — My Baby Bullet-Q" (Sri Publishers, STAR-Q Pass Track), book p.39, printed question 55. Botany-II holds only ONE source book: the TSBIE Basic Learning Material in hand covers physics only, and no Telangana Botany-II board paper is in the corpus, so the two-book union check and the board back-test are BOTH structurally impossible for this card — "not checked" does NOT mean "checked and clean". Run both the moment a second source or a real paper arrives. The mark split is a claim until a Telangana IPE teacher confirms it. Revised 2026-09-05 after the examiner audit: the insider note no longer states what a printed answer scores.

insider_note: One mark for the comparison and one for the reason. The complete answer says pea seeds imbibe more water than wheat seeds AND gives the reason — proteins imbibe more water than carbohydrates.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Which imbibes more
steps.margin_note: Name both storage materials, then state which swells more.
lines: Pea seeds imbibe more water and swell more
steps.why: The comparison follows from what each seed is made of, so naming the two storage materials before the result makes the reason almost automatic.
common_mistakes: Saying wheat imbibes more. PEA imbibes more.
Not naming what each seed stores. Protein against starch is what the answer rests on.
steps.memory_tip: Pea stores protein and drinks more; wheat stores starch and drinks less.

steps.label: The reason
steps.margin_note: State the rule about protein against carbohydrate, not about the seeds.
lines: The imbibing capacity of proteins is greater
So a protein rich seed takes up more water.
steps.why: The rule is about the materials and not the seeds, which is why it also predicts the answer for any other pair of seeds.
common_mistakes: Giving no reason. The reason is a whole mark on a two-mark question.
Saying pea seeds are bigger. Size is not the reason; the storage material is.
steps.memory_tip: It is the protein doing the drinking, not the pea.
